run_s2st: run speech-to-speech translation from a source language audio file to a target language with translated audio and text output
run_s2tt: run speech-to-text translation from a source language audio file to a target language text output
run_t2st: run text-to-speech translation from a source language text input to a target language with translated audio and text output
run_t2tt: run text-to-text translation from a source language text input to a target language text output
run_asr: run automatic speech recognition to transcribe input audio into target language text
